name: Major Project Part II
description:
Students will apply learned theoretical and practical knowledge in solving problems related to power electronics, machines and drives using project based work using simulation tools, designing and building circuits and conducting experiments.
The project work is to be carried out under the supervision of faculty supervisor(s).
